from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        solve = operator.StarWithCoordinator(worker_llm=self.llm, coordinator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_COORD_WORKER_PROMPT] * 3, coordinator_prompt=prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_COORDINATOR_PROMPT, n_rounds=3)
        draft = await solve(problem)
        finalize = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2, prompts=[prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_FINALIZER_REVIEW_PROMPT, prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_FINALIZER_FORMAT_PROMPT])
        solution = await finalize(problem + "\n\nCandidate solution:\n" + draft["response"])
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

Puzzle:
{problem}

Round: {round}
Agent: {agent_id}
Coordinator directive:
{directive}

- Keep all trees X exactly unchanged.

- Match every column count exactly.

- No two tents may touch horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
- Every tree must have at least one horizontally/vertically adjacent tent.
- Before answering, re-check counts and all tent adjacencies.

Return only one candidate board:
<begin_board>
[board with space-separated cells]
<end_board>

Puzzle:
{problem}

Round: {round}
Is final: {is_final}

{worker_outputs}

Your task:
- Compare candidates for exact row counts, exact column counts, total tents, no touching tents including diagonals, unchanged trees, and tree adjacency coverage.
- If a candidate has explanation text, ignore the explanation and focus on the board.
- Prefer candidates that satisfy global counts over local-looking placements.
- If no candidate is fully valid, issue a short corrective directive targeting the most likely global mistake.

If is_final is true, return only:
<begin_board>
[final board with space-separated cells]
<end_board>
"""
